roles_scope_tenant_check.name: roles_scope_tenant_check
roles_scope_tenant_check.value:
("roles"."scope" = 'PLATFORM' and "roles"."tenant_id" is null)
        or ("roles"."scope" = 'HOSPITAL' and "roles"."tenant_id" is not null)

doctor_leaves_approval_check.name: doctor_leaves_approval_check
doctor_leaves_approval_check.value: "doctor_leaves"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("doctor_leaves"."approved_by" is not null and "doctor_leaves"."approved_at" is not null)

doctor_leaves_rejection_check.name: doctor_leaves_rejection_check
doctor_leaves_rejection_check.value: "doctor_leaves"."status" <> 'REJECTED' or ("doctor_leaves"."rejected_by" is not null and "doctor_leaves"."rejected_at" is not null)

patient_contacts_reachable_check.name: patient_contacts_reachable_check
patient_contacts_reachable_check.value: "patient_contacts"."phone" is not null or "patient_contacts"."email" is not null

billing_documents_source_check.name: billing_documents_source_check
billing_documents_source_check.value:
("billing_documents"."document_type" = 'INVOICE' and "billing_documents"."payment_id" is null and "billing_documents"."refund_id" is null)
        or ("billing_documents"."document_type" = 'PAYMENT_RECEIPT' and "billing_documents"."payment_id" is not null and "billing_documents"."refund_id" is null)
        or ("billing_documents"."document_type" = 'CREDIT_NOTE' and "billing_documents"."refund_id" is not null)
